mapper.insert: insert into bbs_collect_activity( title, activity_type, status, creator_user_id, creator_nick_name, scope_type, scope_value, start_time, end_time, anonymous_flag, realtime_flag, limit_once_flag, biz_id, participant_count, banner_url, rule_text, remark, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{title}, #{activityType}, #{status}, #{creatorUserId}, #{creatorNickName}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeValue}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{anonymousFlag}, #{realtimeFlag}, #{limitOnceFlag}, #{bizId}, #{participantCount}, #{bannerUrl}, #{ruleText}, #{remark}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select activity_id, title, activity_type, status, creator_user_id, creator_nick_name, scope_type, scope_value, start_time, end_time, anonymous_flag, realtime_flag, limit_once_flag, biz_id, participant_count, banner_url, rule_text, remark, create_time, update_time from bbs_collect_activity where activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.update: update bbs_collect_activity set status = 'DELETED', update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId}
update bbs_collect_activity set participant_count = participant_count + 1, update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_collect_participation(activity_id, activity_type, user_id, user_nick_name, submit_status, submit_time, create_time) values(#{activityId}, #{activityType}, #{userId}, #{userNickName}, #{submitStatus}, #{submitTime}, now()) on duplicate key update user_nick_name = values(user_nick_name), submit_status = values(submit_status), submit_time = values(submit_time)

insert into bbs_vote(title, description, vote_type, start_time, end_time, status, creator_user_id, creator_nick_name, create_time) values(#{title}, #{description}, #{voteType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{creatorUserId}, #{creatorNickName}, now())
insert into bbs_vote_option(vote_id, option_text, sort_order, vote_count) values(#{voteId}, #{optionText}, #{sortOrder}, 0)
mapper.select: select vote_id, title, description, vote_type, start_time, end_time, status, creator_user_id, creator_nick_name, create_time from bbs_vote where vote_id = #{voteId}
select option_id, vote_id, option_text, sort_order, vote_count from bbs_vote_option where vote_id = #{voteId} order by sort_order asc, option_id asc
mapper.insert: insert ignore into bbs_vote_record(vote_id, option_id, user_id, create_time) values(#{voteId}, #{optionId}, #{userId}, now())
mapper.update: update bbs_vote_option set vote_count = vote_count + 1 where option_id = #{optionId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from bbs_vote_record where vote_id = #{voteId} and user_id = #{userId}
select count(distinct user_id) from bbs_vote_record where vote_id = #{voteId}
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_demand_form(title, description, form_schema, status, creator_user_id, creator_nick_name, create_time) values(#{title}, #{description}, #{formSchema}, #{status}, #{creatorUserId}, #{creatorNickName}, now())
mapper.select: select form_id, title, description, form_schema, status, creator_user_id, creator_nick_name, create_time from bbs_demand_form where form_id = #{formId}
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_collect_demand_ticket( activity_id, form_id, submit_user_id, submit_nick_name, demand_name, demand_type, demand_detail, priority, attachment_urls, contact_person, custom_field_json, status, assignee_user_id, assignee_nick_name, process_comment, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{activityId}, #{formId}, #{submitUserId}, #{submitNickName}, #{demandName}, #{demandType}, #{demandDetail}, #{priority}, #{attachmentUrls}, #{contactPerson}, #{customFieldJson}, #{status}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{assigneeNickName}, #{processComment}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select ticket_id, activity_id, form_id, submit_user_id, submit_nick_name, demand_name, demand_type, demand_detail, priority, attachment_urls, contact_person, custom_field_json, status, assignee_user_id, assignee_nick_name, process_comment, create_time, update_time from bbs_collect_demand_ticket where ticket_id = #{ticketId}
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_topic_activity(title, content, start_time, end_time, status, join_count, creator_user_id, creator_nick_name, create_time) values(#{title}, #{content}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, 0, #{creatorUserId}, #{creatorNickName}, now())
mapper.select: select activity_id, title, content, start_time, end_time, status, join_count, creator_user_id, creator_nick_name, create_time from bbs_topic_activity where activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into bbs_topic_activity_join(activity_id, user_id, user_nick_name, remark, create_time) values(#{activityId}, #{userId}, #{userNickName}, #{remark}, now())
mapper.update: update bbs_topic_activity set join_count = join_count + 1 where activity_id = #{activityId}
update bbs_topic_activity set status = 'closed', archived_flag = '1', summary_text = #{summaryText} where activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_collect_topic_content(activity_id, content_type, content_id, content_title, author_user_id, author_nick_name, score, like_count, comment_count, sort_order, create_time) values(#{activityId}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{contentTitle}, #{authorUserId}, #{authorNickName}, #{score}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{sortOrder}, now())
mapper.select: select id, activity_id, content_type, content_id, content_title, author_user_id, author_nick_name, score, like_count, comment_count, sort_order, create_time from bbs_collect_topic_content where activity_id = #{activityId} order by sort_order asc, score desc, id desc

select author_user_id as userId, max(author_nick_name) as nickName, count(1) as submitCount, sum(score) as totalScore, sum(like_count) as likeCount from bbs_collect_topic_content where activity_id = #{activityId} group by author_user_id order by totalScore desc, likeCount desc, submitCount desc limit 50
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_collect_survey_question(activity_id, question_no, question_type, question_title, option_json, jump_logic_json, required_flag, create_time) values(#{activityId}, #{questionNo}, #{questionType}, #{questionTitle}, #{optionJson}, #{jumpLogicJson}, #{requiredFlag}, now())

insert into bbs_collect_survey_response(activity_id, user_id, user_nick_name, answers_json, submit_status, submit_time, create_time, update_time) values(#{activityId}, #{userId}, #{userNickName}, #{answersJson}, #{submitStatus}, #{submitTime}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update user_nick_name = values(user_nick_name), answers_json = values(answers_json), submit_status = values(submit_status), submit_time = values(submit_time), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select response_id, activity_id, user_id, user_nick_name, answers_json, submit_status, submit_time, create_time, update_time from bbs_collect_survey_response where activity_id = #{activityId} and user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from bbs_collect_survey_response where activity_id = #{activityId} and submit_status = 'SUBMITTED'

select response_id, activity_id, user_id, user_nick_name, answers_json, submit_status, submit_time, create_time, update_time from bbs_collect_survey_response where activity_id = #{activityId} and submit_status = 'SUBMITTED' order by submit_time desc, response_id desc
